note: Ninebark (Physocarpus opulifolius) in 0.9.170: the flowers redrawn from the gardener's photographs ('Summer Wine', 'Amber Jubilee' and the straight species), and eleven cultivars added. Every drawn size was solved from the species with dev/cultivar-size.cjs (a shrub draws near true scale and scales linearly). Height and spread are the source's range, taken at its middle or as the single figure it gives.

sources.mbg: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, https://plantfinder.mobot.org/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=<id> (Physocarpus opulifolius 286432, 'Center Glow' 265989, 'Dart's Gold' 267865, 'Diabolo' 255943, 'Donna May' 293650, 'Jefam' AMBER JUBILEE 293651, 'Mindia' COPPERTINA 265913, 'N5' PANTHER 445999, 'Nanus' 252769, 'Podaras 3' LEMON CANDY 365767, 'Ruby Spice' 272054, 'Seward' SUMMER WINE 262084, 'SMNPMS' SUMMER WINE BLACK 458487, 'SMPOTW' TINY WINE 359227), read 2026-11-25
sources.pw: Proven Winners, https://www.provenwinners.com/plants/physocarpus/<slug> (ginger-wine, summer-wine, summer-wine-black, summer-wine-ros, tiny-wine, tiny-wine-gold, festivus-gold, pickleball, coppertina), read 2026-11-25
sources.rhs: Royal Horticultural Society, Physocarpus opulifolius [Diable D'Or] ('Mindia'), https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/252168/physocarpus-opulifolius-diable-dor-mindia/details, found by search 2026-11-25: Diable D'Or and Coppertina are trade names of 'Mindia'
sources.photos: The gardener's photographs, 2026-11-25: 'Summer Wine' (two: an arching shrub and a mound, near-black wine-red leaves covered in pinkish-white balls), 'Amber Jubilee' (three: gold-green with orange new growth and white heads; red seed clusters after the bloom; a close-up of a corymb of white flowers with pink-tipped stamens over coral leaves) and the straight species (two: green, arching, covered in white domes).

flowers.what: mbg (species): 'small pink or white, five-petaled flowers appearing in dense, flat, rounded, 1-2 in diameter, spirea-like clusters (corymbs) in late spring. Flowers give way to drooping clusters of reddish fruit (inflated seed capsules). Ovate to rounded, usually 3-5 lobed leaves (to 4 in long)'. pw (Ginger Wine): 'Clusters of white flowers cover the plant in late spring, and these age to attractive red seed heads'. mbg (Tiny Wine): 'pink buds that open into white to light pink flowers'. mbg (Lemon Candy): 'red capsules from early to mid fall'.
flowers.drawn: bloomStyle 'corymb' (draw.js corymbSites): a domed head on short side shoots all along each flowering cane, headsAlong to a twig, alternating above and below the cane; pink in bud before they open (the season's eye colour), white or pale pink open with a touch of pink from the buds and anthers. It replaced 'cluster', eight specks at a few twig ends. seedStyle 'follicles': the same heads carry a knot of inflated pods, red in summer and fall, brown in winter, half of them gone by then. leafShape 'lobed3': a three-lobed, maple-like leaf.
flowers.cost: A procedural bake in headless Chrome, min of 7, the species and four cultivars against the old cluster drawing: summer 0.66-1.31 ms against 0.53-0.92; fall 0.38-0.86 against 0.34-0.65; winter 0.25-0.44 against 0.14-0.69. Rotated ellipses for the pods cost a millisecond a bake and were replaced by unrotated ones.

ninebark.estimates: Kept at 8 x 8 ft, as before; zones widened from 3-8 to MBG's 2-8.

diabolo.estimates: Size kept at the species' 8 x 8 ft. 'Monlo' is the name it is registered under in the US (mbg, the 'Center Glow' page).

summerwine.estimates: 5 x 5 ft. Foliage darkened to the photographs' near-black wine red (#46262e); flowers pinkish-white; arching habit (pw: 'graceful, arching habit').

summerwineblack.leaves: nearly black, small, on upright stems (pw)

summerwinerose.estimates: 6.5 x 6.5 ft, arching (pw: 'attractive arching habit'). No registered cultivar name was found.

tinywine.flowers: pink buds opening white to light pink
tinywine.estimates: 4 x 3.5 ft, rounded; heads down most of each cane (headsFrom 0.15).

littledevil.estimates: 4 x 4 ft; narrow plain leaves and small heads.

panther.leaves: about 3 x 2.5 in, purple-black all season

ladyinred.cultivar: 'Lady in Red' (mbg: patented under that name, marketed as 'Ruby Spice')
ladyinred.leaves: red in spring, darker burgundy-red by summer
ladyinred.estimates: 4 x 4.5 ft; pods burgundy-red (mbg: 'Seed capsules turn burgundy red when dried').

gingerwine.estimates: 5.5 x 5.5 ft, upright; orange new growth over burgundy. No registered cultivar name was found.

centerglow.leaves: emerge greenish-gold and age to burgundy, showing both colours
centerglow.estimates: 7 x 7 ft; gold new growth over burgundy. Drawn on the species' arching habit: on the vase habit it read as a flat dome on a bare stalk.

coppertina.leaves: copper-orange in spring, rich red by summer (mbg); coppery-orange all season (pw)
coppertina.estimates: 7 x 7 ft; copper-orange new growth over red-bronze.

amberjubilee.leaves: 'showy orange foliage with yellow veins on new growth in spring and summer before turning purple in fall. Foliage on old wood is green in summer.'
amberjubilee.estimates: 5.5 x 4 ft, upright (the photographs). Summer foliage gold-green (#aaa83e) with orange new growth, where it was olive (#8a8a4c); purple in fall, where it was orange-red.

dartsgold.height: 4-5 ft ('typically matures to 5 ft tall and as wide')
dartsgold.leaves: bright golden yellow in spring, chartreuse/lime green by midsummer, yellow tinted bronze in fall

lemoncandy.leaves: lemon yellow in spring maturing to chartreuse, no appreciable fall colour
lemoncandy.estimates: 2.5 x 3 ft; red pods in fall.

nanus.estimates: 2 x 2.5 ft, a low mound. mbg (the 'Seward' page): the seed parent of Summer Wine.

left_out.tinywinegold: pw: 'no longer available from Proven Winners'.
left_out.festivusgold: pw: 'no longer available from Proven Winners'; Dart's Gold and Lemon Candy cover a gold ninebark.
left_out.pickleball: pw: a new chartreuse dwarf, 2.5-3 x 3-4 ft; Lemon Candy fills the same place and has an MBG page. Worth adding if it becomes common.
